half_power: frozen noise + TOP_signal/2, TOP already net; no second subtraction

edges.selection: first valid rise / last valid fall
edges.local_fit: k-3..k+4, clipped to RAW; at least4 points; root must stay in crossing bracket
edges.variance: two-point noise propagation; OLS uses max(power-noise variance, fit residual variance); inverse-variance fusion is a heuristic ignoring covariance

spectral.binning: frozen coarse interval into8 equal coordinate bins; exact populated pair midpoint mean for each bin
spectral.frequency_reference: residual frequency at RAW sample index0/gsc_first; fixed RFDC NCO sign binding remains physical
spectral.chirp: Hz/s; LS phase increment vs pair midpoint; no per-sample atan2
spectral.ambiguity: invalidate excessive phase jumps; do not invent Nyquist/chirp unwrap
spectral.coherence: 4*abs(sum complex product)^2 >= sum power(first)*sum power(second), i.e. coherence squared >=1/4; unequal H/V gains do not falsely fail

phase.normalization: largest absolute input has highest bit44 before vectoring; arithmetic shifts
phase.zero_vector: invalid output with explicit error; never a valid zero phase

limits: Digital fixed-point behavior, one-pass access, 32-sample cache and 48-DSP engine are verified separately from this numerical contract. Numerical Q16 resolution and tested CORDIC error do not imply physical calibration accuracy. See docs/v06_fine_integration.md for measured workload and board acceptance boundaries.

fixed_edge.fit: signed48 slope/intercept/root numerators; exact bounded signed256 rational variance reference
fixed_edge.outputs: unsigned32 Q16 indices, unsigned64 Q32 variances; round nearest with exact half away from zero; variance min1 LSB
fixed_edge.overflow: variance outside unsigned64 invalidates edge with VARIANCE_OVERFLOW, no wrap

fixed_spectral.pair: signed33 I/Q complex products; signed48 per-segment and HV accumulators
fixed_spectral.centers: exact pair midpoint mean rounded to unsigned32 Q16
fixed_spectral.least_squares: signed256 checked reference numerators/denominators; frequency i32 at gsc_first, chirp i64; nearest ties away from zero
fixed_spectral.body: use emitted Q16 edge indices, ceil rise +4 through floor fall -4
fixed_spectral.snr: floor(max(mean-N,0)*65536/N), saturate unsigned32; known N=0 saturates with explicit model saturation indication
